description: Register an existing S3 URI in your registered bucket as an EdgeGate Artifact. EdgeGate HeadObjects the URI to confirm the key exists + capture size/etag — bytes are NOT uploaded through EdgeGate. Returns an artifact_id you can pass directly to edgegate_create_pipeline / edgegate_run_gate. Requires admin role. Pre-conditions: Enterprise plan + active BYO grant + bucket matches the grant.

expected_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the object (hex). If supplied, downstream cells will fail with BYO_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH when the actual bytes don't match — a strong guarantee that you ran what you thought you ran.

expected_size.description: Optional size in bytes. EdgeGate cross-checks against the HeadObject response and rejects the registration if they disagree — protects against stale pointers when an object was overwritten in S3.

original_filename.description: Optional display filename for run reports.

s3_uri.description: Full S3 URI of the object in your registered bucket, e.g. s3://my-bucket/models/mobilenet-v2.onnx. Must live in the same bucket the grant was registered with.

name: edgegate_register_byo_artifact
